target_customer: Large hospitals, health plans and multi physician groups that want AI agents for back office work
problem: Hospitals are hesitant to adopt AI and lack engineers to build and govern agents. Wedge forward deploys engineers to build, monitor and maintain custom agents for tasks such as claims, coding and records retrieval.
business_model: services led B2B contracts with a shared agent platform

founders.name: Devraj Gopal
education: Stanford (AI), per YC page; degree not stated
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: worked on health AI at Stanford and Johns Hopkins Medicine.

founders.name: Steven Segawa
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: built ML models and fine tuned LLMs.

technical_complexity.rationale: Building agents on top of existing LLMs with EHR and payer integrations is standard engineering; the hard parts are integration, compliance and reliability.

defensibility.rationale: Forward deployed integrations create stickiness, but a services led model scales slowly and competitors sell similar agents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded agent vendors kept raising and signing hospital deployments through late 2025; no source shows an acquisition of Wedge.

market_need_then: Health systems faced administrative burden and staffing pressure in 2025 and were piloting agents cautiously, with governance a stated concern.

branding.domain_note: Uses wedge.health; the operating company is shown as Supermodel AI, Inc. on its site.

identity.visual_style: Clean and modular with numbered steps
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and results driven, focused on ROI and savings

brand_strength.rationale: A short word with a clear wedge into hospitals strategy, but no press or community evidence, and many companies use the Wedge name.

outcome_analysis: Wedge joined YC in Summer 2025 with a two person team selling forward deployed health AI agents. Its site claims pilots at 60 plus locations and 1.8M plus patients served, which are company claims. No exit, shutdown or verified funding was found, so the outcome is open and the company is early.
notes: Unverified: aggregators report a $500K pre-seed in September 2025 from Berkeley Frontier Fund, J20 Ventures, Pioneer Fund, Skarlo and Valia Ventures, and one reports $1M total. No primary source, so no round is recorded. The YC pitch changed between a trust and governance layer for health AI and a forward deployed agent firm. Competitor results were undated listicles and later 2025 funding news, so the list is empty. Founder education for Gopal is only given as ex Stanford AI.
